originality.rationale: The full all-subgroup geometric fixed-graph classification and quotient homotopy spectrum are not stated or implied as topological conclusions by inspected unrestricted fixed-partition enumeration (Hanlon), the ordinary and equivariant homology of divisible partition lattices (Wachs), or their convex-ear decomposition (Woodroofe). Some individual counts and rational quotient Betti numbers are antecedent consequences, explicitly excluded from standalone novelty. Substantial residual risk: an unindexed equivariant divisible-partition theorem could cover this result.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification at the first nontrivial rank of the p-divisible partition lattice gives actual geometric fixed component structures and all ordinary quotient homotopy types for an infinite prime family. The disconnected reflection-star and isolated rotation-fixed configurations are not discernible from ordinary rational symmetry characters; the exact h,f spectrum supplies useful equivariant information beyond a finite table.
